cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on the pottery prize. Turn the handle toward the photographer; that side is genuinely lovely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The judges liked the whole mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please support the base while you lift it; they were wonderfully relaxed about that crack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They called the crack deliberate. It's part of the design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How bold. Keep their comment beside it at the exhibition, please. I'd hate anyone to mistake your award-winning design for the fault I repaired in mine.
